Method of Attack: Deployed malware dropper delivering Godzilla web shells to gain and maintain access
Open-source backdoor used for maintaining access
Credential stealer hooking into Windows LSASS API to capture credentials
Impacted Systems: Local domain controllers (Active Directory database and SYSTEM hive)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2021-40539 vulnerability in Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus allowing remote code execution without authentication
Indicators of Compromise: Compromised servers running vulnerable Zoho software
Exfiltration of Active Directory database file (ntds.dit) and SYSTEM hive
